title: Width is read via stdout?.columns (Node TTY API), consistent with the pre-exist…
body: Width is read via stdout?.columns (Node TTY API), consistent with the pre-existing line 189 usage. Ink 7 also exposes a useWindowSize() hook that returns { columns, rows }; a future refactor could unify width reads on it. Non-blocking and out of scope for this surgical cosmetic fix.
